name: Stochastic Simulation Development and Analysis
description: Stochastic simulation definition; types of stochastic simulation: Monte Carlo, discrete-event, and agent-based; simulation development process: conceptual modeling, input modeling, programming, verification and validation, output modeling and analysis; random number and random variate generation; number of replications; output estimators and variance reduction; simulation experiment design; simulation optimization: ranking and selection, locally and globally convergent random search methods.
